target.title: fix(anthropic): seed API-key default models using own entries
target.body:
### What Problem This Solves

Anthropic API-key model defaulting used `in` when deciding whether an allowlisted model ref already existed. If the model map inherited one of those refs, default seeding skipped creating an own model entry, leaving the effective config dependent on prototype state.

### Why This Change Was Made

Use an own-property check before skipping allowlist seeding. Existing own model entries are still preserved, while inherited refs no longer block the canonical default entry from being written.

### User Impact

API-key Anthropic profiles get the expected own default model entries even when the input model object has inherited refs. Existing own model config remains unchanged.

### Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/anthropic/config-defaults.own-entries.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/anthropic/config-defaults.ts extensions/anthropic/config-defaults.own-entries.test.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --threads=1 extensions/anthropic/config-defaults.ts extensions/anthropic/config-defaults.own-entries.test.ts`
- `env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENAI_ORG_ID -u OPENAI_PROJECT_ID .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` (exit 0, no findings)
